notes.title: Golf Club Architect June 2025 Update (0.70.0)
notes.content:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41277369/400884a9b483f32b2e09a0e5c7e8c327ed74a3aa.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Dear Golfers,[/p][p][/p][p]In this update we present to you two significant changes as well as plenty of bug fixes for issues reported by the community. Regrettably the changes in this update have required us to update the save game format thus rendering saves from previous updates as incompatible.

We endeavor to minimize save game breaking changes and aim to bundle them up into few and far between releases. We're anticipating that the next few updates will be smaller and not break save games. Once we feel we're close to a 1.0 version of the game we'll lock down the save game format and provide forward compatibility from there.
[/p][p]Thanks for your patience.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Day/Night Cycle[/b][/h3][p][/p][p]At the inception of Golf Club Architect I wanted it to be pretty realistic. I wanted tee-times, accurate day lengths and the course to take a realistic length of time to play. This all sounds good but it's very hard to balance, isn't fun and is complicated to implement.[/p][p][/p][p]Previously wee removed fixed tee times in favour of having golfers turn up regularly but in proportion to the rating of your course and this proved much easier to manage and balance. The glaring issue that this left us with was that for a full length 18 hole course a golfer starting at 8am would not finish. We had regular complaints about this. It's very difficult to get the golfers to play a pace that is sane as there are so many factors involved in completing a round.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41277369/d10499af5650d929406d1f523381ae10913f6bfe.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]As of this update the day/night cycle is broken down into discrete segments. The current segment for the day is displayed as an icon in the top left next to the date. These segments are as follows:[/p][p] [/p][p]- Dawn[/p][p]- Morning[/p][p]- Midday[/p][p]- Afternoon[/p][p]- Dusk[/p][p]- Night[/p][p][/p][p]Golfers will only turn up during Morning, Midday and Afternoon and those that turn up in the Morning and Midday segments are guaranteed to finish their rounds. The Afternoon -> Dusk transition will be postponed until those golfers have finished. Golfer spawning in the afternoon will play until they deem it to be too dark to continue.[/p][p][/p][p]The other reason for introducing segments is to support the next feature we've added...[/p][p][/p][h3] [b]1v1 Challenges[/b][/h3][h3] [/h3][p]At the heart of the game is playing your course and until now we've only offered the ability to do this through practicing a hole or a round. As of this update a new challenges window has been added to the top bar and within this will be any challenges that have been made to you.[/p][p][/p][p]Challenges are unlocked after you pass the "Local 6 Hole Course" milestone and come in three degrees of difficulty. Easy, medium and hard.[/p][p] [/p][p]The frequency at which challenges become available is based on lots of factors, chief of which is the rating of your course. The better your course the more often challenges appear.[/p][p][/p][p] [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41277369/7a2a5bd384fc2586a7f68534e299a3b549d22754.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]To accept a challenge visit the challenges window using the trophy button on the top bar and click the accept button for the challenge you wish to play. Once accepted the UI will change over to Play mode which has now been enhanced to show a live leaderboard and the score of the golfer currently playing their shot just like live TV golf.[/p][p] [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41277369/c54a640f8903b9f13c198b4d531ce342c9a96e8b.png"][/img][/p][p]Ending a challenge, either by winning, losing or quitting will show the competition results window which will tell you how much you did or should have won.[/p][p][/p][p]Implementing challenges has been a large effort that's required considerable changes to the way the golfer AI is written. We've done considerable soaking of the game to unearth any issues so we're hoping we've covered everything. The surface area of the game is getting large now so we please ask for your patience and understanding if any small issues are found. We would also ask you to report any such issues in our Discord and we'll jump on them right away.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Quality Of Life[/b][/h3][p][/p][p]We've also made some minor changes and bug fixes, these include but are not limited to:[/p][p][/p][list][*][p]Added a light at the cursor location for the Night, Dawn and Dusk segments so it's easier to build.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed being able to paint other surfaces over green presets.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed terrain Level Of Detail not always drawing correctly leaving seams.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue with shot selection which caused golfers to take shortcuts across non-fairway surfaces.[/p][/*][/list][p]  [/p][p]As always we're eager to hear your feedback on the changes we make. If you've not already done so please join our discord community.[/p][p][/p][p]Thanks and happy golfing![/p][p]
[b]The Golf Club Architect Team[/b][/p][p]
[/p]

notes.title: Golf Club Architect Update 0.47
notes.content:
Dear Golfers,

Welcome to the first major update of 2024! This update introduces a new water simulation, a replacement navigation system, and many bug fixes and quality-of-life improvements.

[h2]Water Simulation[/h2]

In the previous version of the game, water was just a single plane in the game world, limiting players' ability to create new ponds and rivers.

This update introduces the foundations of a new water system where water flows and accumulates as expected, in real-time, as terrain is edited. We are also providing some initial props to get you started:

[list]
[*] [b]Water Outlet[/b] for spawning water at a location.
[*] [b]Water Drains[/b] for removing water.
[*] [b]Gully Tool[/b] to create streams easily.
[*] [b]Pond Presets.[/b]
[/list]

The new water system also opens up the possibility of integration with gameplay elements later. For example, golfers being stuck in water/drowning, course wear and flooding, heavy rainfall causing problems, and trees/foliage absorbing water. These features are all to come.

Please note that the new water system is more computationally expensive than the previous approach. Let us know how it performs for you.

[h2]Navigation[/h2]

Until now, we've been using a popular third-party library for our AI navigation, which only took us so far. One of the hardest technical challenges in this release was developing a bespoke navigation system that is both fast at finding paths and responsive to water changes. We believe we've found the solution, but we would love your feedback and testing.

The new navigation system also opens up the following possibilities for future releases:

[list]
[*] Multiple layers of navigation for golfers to avoid walking over bunkers when they shouldn’t.
[*] Buggies navigating correctly with turning circles and favoring paths.
[*] Better handling of feature bridges and eventual custom-shaped bridges.
[*] Different navigation graphs for different agent types, such as animals.
[/list]

We have some more work here to improve the paths and performance but first we wanted to get something in your hands to play with.

## Quality of Life

We've fixed many bugs and tweaked minor elements. Here is a small sample:

[list]
[*] More practice greens.
[*] Gully and ridge terrain tools.
[*] New terrain tool icons.
[*] Better tooltips.
[*] Bridge placement decals.
[*] Resolution scale option.
[/list]

As a development team, we feel that these features are the last really risky changes we’re making. We anticipate that we can resume our schedule of more frequent updates for the rest of the year. If you find any issues, want to discuss features or make any suggestions please feel free to join our Discord.

Thanks for your patience and happy golfing!

[b]The Golf Club Architect Team[/b]

notes.title: Update 0.47
notes.content:
[h2]Features[/h2]

[list]
[*] Added water simulation.
[*] Added the concept of flooding so buildings and features can be flooded and become unusable.
[*] Added small, medium, and large square practice greens, and a small rounded practice green.
[*] Added the ability to reorder holes in the hole list.
[*] Added tooltips to explain why a prop can't be placed.
[*] Added golfer reactions when you select them.
[*] Added the ability to select practice greens.
[*] Added a display to view the available and completed achievements for custom golfers.
[*] Added a gully tool to help create streams and other terrain features.
[*] Added a ridge tool to help you more easily create sharp ridges.
[*] Added notifications for when golfers miss their tee time due to course mismanagement.
[*] Added open/closed state to practice nets and practice greens.

notes.title: Golf Club Architect Update #1 Announcement
notes.content:
Greetings Golf Fans,

We’re delighted to announce that our first major update since entering Early Access is arriving tomorrow but firstly we’d like to extend a big thank you to everyone who has bought the game so far. You’re making a leap of faith paying for a new game in Early Access and we really appreciate the support. All of the money we receive is being invested back into the game.

Secondly I just wanted to recap our general plan when it comes to Golf Club Architect releases. With the game being in Early Access we anticipate needing to break save game compatibility as we add the foundations of new systems. We also understand that players don’t want their saves broken constantly and so we have come up with a plan to release 4 big updates a year where we break save compatibility but we will ship many more small updates in between that don’t. 

This update is the first big save game breaking update and comes with a host of new features, some of which are described in this post and will be in your hands this Sunday.

[h2]Milestones[/h2]

One of the main problems with the first Early Access version of the game was that we didn’t define or communicate the objective to you, in this update we are beginning to add this content. A new milestone system has been added along with the first 4 milestones. Milestones have criteria that need to be met in order to achieve them and also come with rewards such as cash injections and unlocking of course features.

Don’t worry, if you’re used to playing in Sandbox mode where there are no restrictions at all then this remains true. Milestones are not enabled for Sandbox mode.

Milestone information window:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41277369/1d9c2abb18b5c376bc4eb54a66df45e919e4cb95.png[/img]

Milestone goals window:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41277369/9a0b18636b1e8bc61fa638e370e9b3bbaabd9a86.png[/img]

[h2]Course Rating[/h2]
The next area we have improved is providing direction on how to improve your course, detailing to you it’s current greatness (or otherwise). In this update we have laid the foundations for the Course Rating system.

Much like in real life when a golfer visits a golf course they can leave a review. Golf Club Architect golfers will do the same.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41277369/d44f3091775a24359bbc9b14c30b91e1a33f2404.png[/img]

In the new Club Management window you will be able to find information on how your course is currently rated as well as who has left those ratings. Each course will initially be rated in three categories, Beauty, Pace and Happiness.

Beauty is affected by whether the golfers notice beautiful props as they play their round of golf. For example a big oak tree will be especially beautiful and a small tree less so.

Pace rating is determined by whether the golfers can play their round of golf at the speed at which they’d wish to do so.

Happiness is affected by the results of their game on the course. Build a hole where players hit it into the water too much and they’ll become unhappy. Make a hole too easy and they will also become unhappy. Finding the correct balance is key.

[h2]Finances[/h2]

You complained that you were running out of money in Scenario mode too quickly and we here you. We had always planned to improve the finance system in the game but due to your feedback we have brought that forward to the first update.

As well as the rewards for the milestones listed above we have also added a loan system which will allow you to dig yourself out of a financial hole should the worst come to the worst. We have added a tab to the Course Management window allowing you to see what you’re spending your money on as well as take out the aforementioned loans.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41277369/500cf5320f15cc5dcea4c225cfee221b7279451c.png[/img]

Time Scale

In this update we have also addressed the time-scale issues we discovered while implementing loans. Fundamentally time wasn’t moving forward fast enough for the loans to be repaid in a plausible amount of real-world time and this is because the in-game time going through a full calendar cycle.

To address this we have reduced the calendar to 5 days in a month. We feel that this will need to be balanced further in the future and we also think that we might add this as a new game option where, for example, you could even choose to play a full calendar should you so choose.


Notable Tweaks

We have also fixed many bugs and made lots of small quality of life improvements to the game. Here are some of them:


[list]
[*] Green & Bunker presets - Preset shapes for greens and bunkers are now provided to help you kick start your golf course.
[*] Ambient music - Two ambient music tracks have been added to accompany you during your golf course development.
[*] Improved terrain surface visuals with normal maps and also green/fairway fringes are now applied automatically.
[*] Handicaps - AI golfers now have their stats determined by an initial handicap and the distribution of handicaps amongst the AI golfers is far more like real life where there are far few very good and very poor golfers.
[*] Height Flatten Tool now allows you to select a height with right-click that you wish to paint.
[*] Hole Shape - It is now automatically determined whether a hole is straight or dogleg
[/list]


What next?

We’re already planning the contents of the next big update but rest assured that until then we will ship updates fixing any issues found as well as some smaller features. We will have more information about the contents of the next big update in due course.



Thanks for reading,

The Golf Club Architect development team
